sentences.text: No, the documents do not allow a pre-payment penalty rate for this case because for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, and that applies here to a Tier 3 UCB, floating rate, individual borrower, and sanction date 2026-01-01.
The documents do not state any rate to use for a floating-rate home loan to an individual borrower sanctioned in 2026 because the applicable rule says no pre-payment charges shall be levied.

missing.searched: pre-payment penalty rate for floating-rate home loans to individual borrowers sanctioned in 2026
